set: A: surface and detail, the ten keys whole

issues.where: the broken side pieces: centre left (around 640,440 to 790,500), top centre (870,320 to 1020,390), right edge (1240,390 and 1255,660)
issues.what: each piece has a flat brushed-grey strip sticking out of its torn end. The strip has no thickness, no edge bevel and no shadow of its own, so it looks like a decal or a strip of tape and not torn metal. A loose grey dot also floats off the left end of the centre-left piece
issues.fix: give the torn ends real sheet thickness: a lit top edge, a dark side face, jagged bent edges and a tight contact shadow. Remove the stray dot

issues.file: set-A-01.png, set-A-02.png, set-A-03.png (stage 2), set-A-05.png and set-A-06.png ('the open socket in the rim')
issues.what: the inside of the hole is a soft black blob. There are no inner walls, no floor and no lip lit from the key light, so it reads as a dark spot and not a hole
issues.fix: model the hole's inner wall: lit on the far side, falling into shadow on the near side, with a visible floor or cavity and a crisp edge where the rim meets the opening

issues.where: the cracks around the socket, and in front of the stage-2 cap on the parts sheet
issues.what: the cracks are dark-brown lines of the same width that branch like drawn twigs. They have no depth, no lifted edge and no light-side highlight, and the page surface does not break along them. The chips beside them are grey dots of almost the same size
issues.fix: make the cracks splits in the surface: a dark gap with a lit edge on one side, thick at the socket and thinning out, some lifted flakes of the page, and chips of varied size that cast tight shadows

issues.where: the smoke above the burnt Submit cap and the front plate
issues.what: the smoke is two or three grey squiggles of even width and even opacity. They look like drawn ribbons and not smoke
issues.fix: use soft volumetric wisps that widen, thin out and break up as they rise, are lit on one side and are translucent over the page

issues.where: the cracked shield slab, lower right
issues.what: the cracks in the glass are thin white drawn lines with no refraction, no offset across the break and no chipped edge. The slab is a flat tinted green with nothing showing through
issues.fix: render the fractures as breaks: displaced refraction of the page behind, bright glints along the edges and a chip at the rim. Show the page texture through the slab, slightly distorted

issues.file: set-A-01.png, set-A-04.png, set-A-07.png ('glass at its edge')
issues.what: the glass reads as a flat, mottled grey-green panel. The page texture does not show through, the edge does not refract and the face has no reflection gradient. Only the rim is convincing
issues.fix: let the page grain show through with slight offset and blur, add a soft specular sweep across the face and a refracted, brighter band just inside the bevelled edge

issues.file: set-A-01.png, set-A-05.png ('a shot in flight', 'the arrow')
issues.where: the shots along the line from the arrow to the shield
issues.what: each shot is a small flat white arrowhead with a beige glow under it. They have no thickness, gloss or motion blur, so they look like stamped icons and not projectiles
issues.fix: make each shot a small glossy solid with a highlight and a shaded side, add a short motion streak, and make the glow light the page beneath it

issues.what: the scorch marks look like black paint splats with orange rims laid over the cap, not charred plastic. A thin straight seam line runs the length of the cap through the scorch
issues.fix: blister and darken the plastic into the burnt areas, add bubbling and soot fall-off, and remove or justify the seam

issues.what: the arrow changes material between stills: dark chrome in 01, ivory plastic in 02, and a white fill with a black outline in 04. In 04 it reads closest to a flat cursor with an outline, with only a thin bevel
issues.fix: pick one material and use it in every still, with a visible side wall and a specular highlight

issues.where: the 'Required field' tag, near the lower right of the text
issues.what: a small stray white tick mark sits on the red face of the tag
issues.fix: remove it, or make it clearly a spark from the impact
